text:
Situation: Nitroglycerin ointment from AbbVie Inc. has been on FDA's shortage list with a status of To Be Discontinued since an initial posting date of 2026-04-14. As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 37 months. Current inventory across Corvale sites ranges from 6 to 14 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records nitroglycerin ointment from AbbVie Inc. with a status of To Be Discontinued and an initial posting date of 2026-04-14. The label for NDC 50090326600 names A-S Medication Solutions as the product labeler and plant with FEI 1450743, operations RELABEL and REPACK, and a last inspection classification of VAI on 2026-08-12. FDA inspection records for FEI 1450743 show multiple VAI classifications from 2009 through 2026, with the most recent inspection ending 2026-08-12 and known date 2026-10-14. A Warning Letter was issued to A-S Medication Solutions LLC on 2017-06-05.

Our position: Supply is critically low at all three Corvale sites. The rule-based best option is to buy from Advagen Pharma Ltd., which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place. Four additional manufacturers are also not on FDA's shortage list today but similarly lack identifiable plants on their labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Advagen Pharma Ltd. pending P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Aurobindo Pharma Limited as secondary source pending P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Dr. Reddys Laboratories Inc as tertiary source pending P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to qualify Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA as quaternary source pending P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to qualify Golden State Medical Supply, Inc. as fifth source pending P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement while awaiting AbbVie restock given To Be Discontinued status.
